exposure: Uterine artery Doppler ultrasonography (presence of bilateral notch)
cohort: 200 antenatal mothers (100 high-risk with previous history of hypertension, FGR, IUD; 100 low-risk with no prior history) at 20-22 weeks of gestation.
finding: There is a significant association between bilateral notch on uterine artery Doppler and parity, FGR, and the combined outcome of HT & FGR.
mod_finding: Among the 33 cases with bilateral notch, 14 had caesarean delivery and 19 had vaginal delivery.
